content:
jen: Heads up — we're starting the Nightwatch UI FF ramp from 0->5% cohort tonight at 23:30 UTC.

jen: Plan: cohort nightwatch-1 @ 5% (canary) -> 20% after 15m if telemetry green -> 50% after 1h -> unpin older UI versions for cohort.

mira: tagging @ops-sre for observability checks. Are the dashboards wired for session-load and lat_p95?

ops-sre: dashboards ready. Added alerts: nightwatch.lat_p95 > 300ms for 5m, error-rate > 0.8% for 10m.

ryan: release notes pushed to the repo and rollout doc linked: https://rwd.in/ops/nightwatch-rollout

jen: I'll kick it off with deploy-bot. Command:
```
/deploy-bot ff toggle nightwatch-ui --cohort nightwatch-1 --pct 5 --note "nightwatch canary" --by jen
```

deploy-bot: Received request from jen. Starting toggle. Estimated propagation ~20s.

deploy-bot: toggle nightwatch-ui -> 5% for cohort nightwatch-1 — SUCCESS (txn 0x4f2a)

amanda: seeing initial traffic in cohort nightwatch-1. No errors so far. :thumbsup: 

mira: checking telemetry... p95=210ms, errors=0.12% over 2m.

ops-sre: good. Holding for 15m until next step. Automations will gate at 20m if signals OK.

paul: FYI I'm keeping the older UI pinned for enterprise customers in cohort nightwatch-legacy.

ryan: reminder: if we hit alert thresholds, rollback command is:
```
/deploy-bot ff rollback nightwatch-ui --cohort nightwatch-1 --to 0
```

jen: noted. Also we have a canary monitor that will auto-drift back on sustained latency.

deploy-bot: monitoring hook attached (monitor: nightwatch-canary-health, window: 5m)

mira: at +12m — still green. p95=215ms, errors=0.15%.

amanda: we saw one 502 cluster spike at +13m — transient, internal investigation, not cohort-wide.

ops-sre: spike correlated with upstream auth service during that minute. Not due to FF.

jen: proceeding to step 2. Manual command from me:
```
/deploy-bot ff toggle nightwatch-ui --cohort nightwatch-1 --pct 20 --note "step2" --by jen
```

deploy-bot: toggle nightwatch-ui -> 20% for cohort nightwatch-1 — SUCCESS (txn 0x4f2b)

mira: telemetry at +18m: p95=225ms, errors=0.18% — still under thresholds.

ops-sre: alert windows still clear. continuing.

paul: I'm starting the pin-unset process for test-only users to free slots.

ryan: capturing rollout events to release notes and analytics. Will add a note about auth spike.

jen: agreed. We'll hold at 20% for 1h and then decide on 50% or rollback based on SLOs.

amanda: tagging @security — any concerns on telemetry or feature flags for entitlements?

security: no immediate concerns. Saw the policy checks pass on canary.

jen: thanks everyone. I'll update this thread at 60m and push the consolidated release note.

mira: :eyes:

deploy-bot: automatic gate at +60m scheduled. monitor will evaluate signals and notify this channel.

jen: closing the manual window — leave the auto-gate enabled. If anything changes, call for rollback.
